what: Confetti falls endlessly behind the section. 50 pieces per screen height are scattered one per cell on a 12-column grid, falling straight from 500px above the plate to 500px below in 80~90 seconds, swaying 10~30px sideways over 5~8s and turning once every 10s. Phones and tablets (1279px and below) do not fall but stay in their grid cell, only swaying and turning. The top 100px of the plate is kept empty and the pieces fade in up to 250px.

options.per: Pieces per screen height, default 50 (45 at 769~1279px · 30 at 768px or below)
options.colors: Piece colors — --kf-* variable names separated by spaces, default --kf-accent --kf-accent-soft --kf-accent-text --kf-surface --kf-ink-soft
options.still: With true, it stays on the grid instead of dropping off, even on wide screens
options.--fx-z: z-index of the paper panel, default 0

note: The piece count scales with panel height, so a long section gets hundreds (about 975 on the original first page). Use a lower per where it redraws often, like an app screen
